s.note: Apple and celery with walnuts in creamy dressing.
s.how: Toast the walnuts in a dry pan until fragrant and roughly chop. Whisk the mayo, yoghurt and a squeeze of lemon with salt and pepper. Toss the apple, celery and grapes through the dressing. Pile onto the lettuce leaves and scatter with walnuts.

s.note: Golden crab cakes with lemon remoulade.
s.how: Mix the crab, 60g panko, egg, 3 tbsp mayo, mustard and spring onions and shape 12 small cakes. Coat in the rest of the panko and chill for 10 minutes. Fry in the oil until golden on both sides. Stir the rest of the mayo with the capers, gherkins and lemon and serve alongside.
shop: 3 tbsp whole-egg mayonnaise, plus 4 tbsp for the remoulade@Pantry

m.note: Rare rib roast with horseradish cream and jus.
m.how: Rub the beef with the oil, garlic, thyme and plenty of salt and pepper. Roast on the potatoes at 230C for 20 minutes, then at 160C until rare in the middle. Rest the beef under foil and keep the potatoes warm. Deglaze the tin with the stock for a jus and stir the horseradish into the sour cream. Carve thick slices and serve with the potatoes, jus and horseradish cream.

m.note: Thick pork chops with mustard apples.
m.how: Season the chops and sear in the oil until deep golden on both sides and just cooked, then rest. Melt the butter and fry the apples, onion and sage until caramelised. Add the apple juice and mustard and bubble until glossy. Return the chops with their juices and spoon the apples over.

w.note: Warm double-crust apple pie with vanilla ice cream, a diner slice.
w.how: Line a pie dish with one sheet of pastry. Toss the apples with the sugar, cornflour and cinnamon, pile into the case and dot with butter. Lay over the second sheet, crimp, cut steam holes and brush with egg. Bake at 190C until golden and bubbling, then rest. Serve warm with ice cream.
shop: 6 Granny Smith apples, peeled and sliced@Produce

d.note: Dry gin and tonic with a lime wedge.
d.how: Fill 4 tumblers with ice and pour 60ml gin into each. Top with tonic and squeeze in a lime wedge.

shopping: 3 tbsp whole-egg mayonnaise, plus 4 tbsp for the remoulade@Pantry
6 Granny Smith apples, peeled and sliced@Produce
